data.name: Carmen
data.gender_notes: Carmen is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Christian tradition, the name Carmen is derived from the Latin word 'carmen' meaning 'song, melody, or garden'. This name is associated with the biblical story of the prophetess and poetess,Carmel, who lived in ancient Israel. Carmel was a woman of God who prophesied and sang songs in praise of the Lord. The name Carmen thus represents a creative, musical, and devout spirit.
data.spiritual_meaning: A musical offering to God, reflecting one's devotion and creativity.
data.etymology: Carmen belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Song or melody.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Carmen total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: קַרְמֶן
in_hebrew.meaning: פרי זית, פרי, סמל של אדמה, שמחה, חסד, אדמה, נפלאות, הברכה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קַרְמֶן מקורה בלשון העברית, ופירושה הוא פרי זית, או פרי, והיא סמל של אדמה, שמחה, חסד, והברכה. במסורת היהודית, הקַרְמֶן הוא סמל לפרי ולנפלאות של האדמה, ובמקרא, הוא צוין כאחד הסמלים הראשונים לאדמה בבריאת העולם (בראשית, פרק א', פסוק י'). בתרבות הנוצרית, הקַרְמֶן יכולה לסמל את האדמה, את החיים, ואת הברכה שבהם.

in_greek.name: Καρμέν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καρμέν προέρχεται από τα ελληνικά και σημαίνει δέντρο, δώρο, ή ευλογία. Στη Βίβλο, δεν υπάρχει αναφορά στο όνομα Καρμέν, αλλά στη Βουλγαροσλαβική παράδοση, το όνομα Καρμενα προέρχεται από την λέξη καρμίν, που σημαίνει δέντρο. Σεบาง περιπτώσεις, το όνομα Καρμέν θεωρείται ως συνθετικό από τα ελληνικά καρμός (δέντρο) και το έμφατικό ρήμα -έν (-εν) που σημαίνει ευλογία ή δώρο, σε αναλογία με την ονομασία του Ιησού Χριστού, Χριστός (Χριστός, ο ευλογημένος).

in_latin.name: Carmen
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen «Carmen» originem habet ex lingua Latina, et significat choros, encomium, vel daemonem. In historia Ecclesiae, nomen istud advenit in usu per tempora saeculi undecimi, quando carmina seu cantica religiosa erant gratia Christi. In lingua Latina, carmen significavit «chorus» vel «canio». In historia Ecclesiae, carmen significavit verbum Dei, quod est canio vel chorus, qui celebrat gloriam Dei.

historical_references.context: The Romani people, also known as Gypsies, are believed to have originated in India around the 11th century and migrated westward. They brought their unique culture, including the use of the name Carmen, to Europe.

historical_references.reference: In Christian tradition, the name Carmen is also associated with the Virgin Saint Carmen, who is believed to have lived in the 3rd century in Italy. She is the patron saint of travelers and is often invoked for protection during journeys.
historical_references.context: Saint Carmen is believed to have been a wealthy lady who lived in Italy during the early Christian period. She was known for her great generosity and her deep devotion to the Christian faith. According to legend, she was martyred during the Roman persecutions of Christians.
